title: P18-F supersession-aware recovery + company E2E
description: P18-F: SUPERSEDES finally consumes the relation substrate — recovery for terminally-blocked admission. admissionView() gains a third proven set, superseded_by (ACTIVE SUPERSEDES edges whose `to` is the objective — identical strict proof in index and global-fallback paths). The scheduler's relationGate resolves each unmet DEPENDS_ON upstream through the proven supersession DAG (BFS, visited-set cycle-safe, SUPERSEDE_WALK_CAP=128 nodes): the requirement is satisfied iff ANY reachable node — the upstream itself or a declared replacement — is ACHIEVED. A failed upstream with an achieved declared replacement releases admission; a pending upstream with an achieved replacement releases too (supersession re-points the requirement uniformly, same authority as revoking the edge). R1 repair: proof-budget exhaustion inside the walk is contained as 'unmet' (PROOF_LIMIT → false) — a deep legitimate recovery topology can no longer throw the fair-candidate scan into a permanent rollback livelock; the scan's relationGate call now also sits under the same stoppedOnBudget guard as queue()/lease(). Cap-trip drains already-seen nodes for status checks (any node inside the window can satisfy). Cycles, beyond-cap neighborhoods and unproven/suspended/revoked edges stay gated — transient and owner-authored states fail contained to that objective, never wedge the scan; corrupt rows still propagate loudly. Boundaries held: handoff keeps raw upstream (supersession never expands artifact provenance), duties keep declared coverage (recovery never re-points), CONFLICTS gating unaffected, superseding the dependent itself is lineage metadata not a lease gate, and the portfolio's raw-status satisfaction is documented recovery-unaware advisory. Tests F1–F15 incl. index/fallback parity, cap+drain, cycle, unproven-edge, nested-budget containment probes and a company E2E (business + org_agent duty + relation + terminal failure + declared recovery + admission). Codex-only.
